scope: Exploratory validation ONLY after locator selected on internal TRAIN monitor; no test inference or automatic promotion
intervention: Replace ONLY legacy concentric pupil fallback by selected circular CNN when fixed geometric plausibility checks pass; ordinary pupil holes, outer ellipse, iris support, RGB/native crops, all identity weights and fusion weights unchanged. New geometry applied to S1 enrollment and S2 queries. Reference masks only define artificial query occlusion.
controls: Three fixed strategies: original control; new pupil with original frozen component statistics/threshold; new pupil with CLEAN validation component statistics and CLEAN empirical FMR<=1% threshold. Each strategy parameters unchanged upper/lower10%. No choice of strategy/weights/threshold using occlusion results.
gate: If selected locator does not beat concentric baseline on monitor proxy loss, record gate failure and do NOT extract validation identity scores.
precision: Same original extraction: CNN/Transformer BF16batch128,spatialFP32batch32,ArcIrisFP32batch8. One original query photo, informed side,16 candidates,ALL482 queries/failures retained.
limits: Pupil target is annotation-hole-derived circle proxy, not anatomical pupil ground truth; internal monitor seen by frozen U-Net. Reused development validation and external ArcIris pretraining overlap unknown. No minimum-area claim.
